Old Maid Rules

A card game of luck for children: collect pairs and pass on the Black Peter.

The rules

The cards
The pack holds pairs of animal cards - two equal cards each - and exactly one Black Peter, a black cat with a top hat. With 2 players there are 27 cards, with 3 players 31 and with 4 players 37. The cards show only a picture; the name stands small underneath.
Dealing
All cards are dealt. Everyone lays down the pairs in their hand straight away.
Drawing
In turn, each player draws one hidden card from the player to their left who still has cards. If the card makes a pair, the pair is laid down. A player without cards is out and safe.
The end
When only one player has cards left, that player holds the Black Peter and loses; everyone else wins.
Playing here
You play against 1 to 3 computers. On your turn the hidden cards of the player to your left stand in a row: tap one to draw it. The computers draw at random and shuffle their cards after every turn, so the order tells you nothing.

The cards

The picture shows two animal cards and the Black Peter.
